A way out, one tap away.

1. Look at the arrowhead. It tells you which direction the arrow will leave.

2. Trace a straight line ahead. If another arrow crosses that line, the way is blocked. Clear that arrow first.

3. Tap anywhere on a clear arrow. Its tail follows its path out of the board. Clear them all to finish.

Journey and Daily allow three mistakes. Zen has unlimited attempts. A dashed coral line shows exactly where a blocked move hits. Hints are free and unlimited; using one caps your result at two stars. Undo restores your last successful arrow, but does not erase mistakes.

Keyboard: Tab to an arrow, then Enter or Space. Dots are only guides, never obstacles.
